proposals: The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish state-wise ethanol distillation capacity against OMC allocations and actual offtake every ethanol supply year, so the estimated 277 crore litre surplus in Maharashtra and 77 crore litre shortfall in Tamil Nadu become official figures rather than sector estimates.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish plant-wise capacity utilisation for distilleries built with interest subvention, so the roughly 900 crore litres of excess capacity, and which units sit below 60% utilisation, can be tracked from government data.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should notify a dated blending roadmap beyond E20, stating whether and when E25 or E30 will apply, so distillers and lenders are not building capacity to a target that keeps moving.

NCDC should publish the list of cooperative sugar mills sanctioned under the ₹10,000 crore loan pool, with amounts sanctioned and disbursed and the status of each ethanol or multi-feedstock conversion, so the use of the 90:10 financing by the 229 mills can be checked.

The oil marketing companies should publish, for each tender cycle, the volumes awarded under Priority-1 allocation to mills converted to multi-feedstock operation, so the offtake certainty the DFPD subvention scheme promises can be verified.
